verdict.rationale: Evidence only hints at AI features (AI-powered tax code recommendations, and 'conversational queries' for analyzing accounts) rather than a documented built-in assistant a user can delegate broader tasks to; the MCP server (docs-6/7/8/13, probe-3) is framed as an API surface for external AI agents to call into AvaTax, not an assistant embedded in the product for the user. Missing for 10: a documented in-product chat/assistant UI, description of delegable task scope, and evidence of user-facing conversational workflows beyond a single marketing line.
